subject: general
question: A car driver covers a total distance of 120 km. He covers the first 80 km at a uniform speed of 50 km/h and the next 40 km at a uniform speed of 40 km/h. The average speed of the car is:
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

**Average Speed** = **Total Distance** ÷ **Total Time**

Total Time = (80 ÷ 50) + (40 ÷ 40) = 1.6 + 1 = 2.6 hours

Average Speed = 120 ÷ 2.6 = 1200 ÷ 26 = 600 ÷ 13 km/h

600 ÷ 13 = 46 with a remainder of 2

**∴ The correct answer is 46(2)/(13) km/h.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

First distance (d₁) = 80 km, Speed (s₁) = 50 km/h

Second distance (d₂) = 40 km, Speed (s₂) = 40 km/h

**Formula Used:**

**Average Speed** = (Total Distance) ÷ (Total Time)

Time = Distance ÷ Speed

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/095155e84c6c61903ed78814b66e61b559d46d55a68b2c1aa407ecec00b0ae50.png] 

⇒ Time for first part (t₁) = 80 ÷ 50 = 1.6 hours

⇒ Time for second part (t₂) = 40 ÷ 40 = 1 hour

⇒ **Total Time** = 1.6 + 1 = 2.6 hours

⇒ **Total Distance** = 80 + 40 = 120 km

⇒ **Average Speed** = 120 ÷ 2.6

⇒ **Average Speed** = 120 ÷ (13/5) = (120 × 5) ÷ 13

⇒ **Average Speed** = 600 ÷ 13 = 46 2/13 km/h

**∴ The correct answer is 46(2)/(13) km/h.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Average Speed for Equal Distances

If a person covers equal distances at speeds x and y, then **Average Speed** = 2xy ÷ (x + y).

Unit Conversion

To convert speed from **km/h** to **m/s**, multiply by 5/18. To convert **m/s** to **km/h**, multiply by 18/5.

Relative Speed

For two objects moving in the same direction, Relative Speed = |s₁ − s₂|. For opposite directions, Relative Speed = s₁ + s₂.</p
